source: EXCERPT of brain phys2a-exam3-bank/formula-sheet.json v3 (163 rows): the 8 rows the ladder pilot uses, verbatim, plus a pilot doc.purpose per row (Oct 23, Claude-authored; not yet in the brain sheet). Test fixture only.

doc.purpose: Finds the energy an object has because it moves: kinetic energy KE, from its mass m and speed v.
doc.when: Use for the energy of a moving object.
doc.ex: m = 2 kg, v = 3 m/s → KE = ½·2·3² = 9 J

doc.purpose: Finds how much gravity energy ΔPE changes when a mass m moves up or down by a height Δy.
doc.when: Use near Earth surface for gravity energy change. +y is up.

groups.name: Torque, Moment of Inertia, Rotational Kinetic Energy, Angular Momentum

doc.purpose: Finds how hard a force F twists something about a pivot: the torque τ.

sym.m: distance from pivot to force point

doc.when: Use to find the turning effect of a force about a pivot.

doc.purpose: Finds how hard a set of masses m_i is to spin about an axis: the moment of inertia I.

sym.m: distance of particle i from axis

doc.when: Use for a set of point masses around a fixed axis.

doc.purpose: Finds the energy of a spinning object: rotational kinetic energy KE_r, from moment of inertia I and angular speed ω.
doc.when: Use for the kinetic energy of an object that turns about an axis.

doc.purpose: Finds how much spin a turning body carries: angular momentum L, from moment of inertia I and angular speed ω.
doc.when: Use for the angular momentum of a rigid body about a fixed axis.

doc.purpose: Links twist to spin change: the net torque Στ sets the angular acceleration α and how fast angular momentum L changes.
doc.when: Use to relate net torque to angular acceleration or change in L.

doc.purpose: Says the total angular momentum L stays the same, final L_f equal to initial L_i, when no outside torque acts.
doc.when: Use when the net external torque on the system is zero.
